# Mithila Chitrakala Store

> Mithila Chitrakala Store is a Nepal-based online store offering authentic Mithila and Madhubani-inspired art, handmade crafts, textiles, clothing, home décor, stationery, accessories, and cultural gifts. The store connects customers with traditional Mithila artistic heritage through thoughtfully designed and handcrafted products.

Mithila Chitrakala Store is based in Janakpur Dham, Nepal, the cultural heartland of Mithila. The store focuses on making Mithila art and cultural creativity accessible through both traditional artwork and contemporary products suitable for everyday use, gifting, festivals, and home decoration.

## Official Website

- [Mithila Chitrakala Store](https://mithilachitrakalastore.com.np/): Official online store and primary source for current products, collections, policies, and store information.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://mithilachitrakalastore.com.np/): Store overview, featured products, collections, and latest offerings.
- [Products](https://mithilachitrakalastore.com.np/products): Browse available Mithila art, paintings, handmade crafts, clothing, textiles, home décor, stationery, accessories, and cultural gifts.
- [Cultural Journal](https://mithilachitrakalastore.com.np/journal): Articles and educational content related to Mithila culture, Madhubani art, traditions, festivals, artists, artisans, and cultural heritage.
- [Art Advice](https://mithilachitrakalastore.com.np/advice): AI-assisted guidance and recommendations for selecting art and culturally inspired products.

## Cultural Focus

The store promotes and presents Mithila artistic traditions and culturally inspired designs originating from the Mithila region of Nepal and the broader Mithila cultural heritage.

Mithila art, commonly associated with Madhubani painting, is recognized for its distinctive line work, decorative patterns, symbolic imagery, nature-inspired elements, cultural themes, and traditional visual language.

Products may incorporate traditional or contemporary interpretations of Mithila artistic motifs. Individual product pages should be used to determine the specific design, materials, production method, and authenticity information for each product.

## Authenticity and Artisan Focus

Mithila Chitrakala Store aims to support and showcase Mithila artistic traditions, handmade products, and culturally inspired creations.

Where a product is handmade, hand-painted, artisan-made, or otherwise specifically identified as such, refer to its individual product description for the applicable details.

Claims about the origin, materials, production process, or authenticity of a particular product should be based on the information provided on that product's official store page.
